I also see your Harlo OS question about the slow, frozen web interface is still open, and you shouldn't have had to chase it. Were you after that, or something else?

Hi - following up on my RMA for a BSB NerdOctaxe (12TH/s), order Shop···· (#····), delivered Aug 25. On Sep 21 it showed VREG OVERHEATED (unit cold to the touch) and quit; reboots didn't help. Per support's instructions I reflashed Harlo OS on Sep 29. The flash worked and it joins Wi-Fi and gets an IP, but the web interface is extremely slow and won't respond to any clicks, so I can't configure or run it. I emailed (email hidden) on Sep 29, Oct 2 and Oct 8 with no reply. Please open the RMA and send return instructions and a prepaid label. I'd like a replacement unit.
Handing this to our technical specialist now.

INSTRUCTION FROM THE HELIUMDEPLOY TEAM. Georges typed this in the team inbox. It is not a message from the customer and the customer cannot see it.
Task: Email David ((email hidden), order Shop····, BSB NerdOctaxe 12TH/s) as yourself, Sarah. Thank him for his patience with the troubleshooting on the VREG overheating. To open his RMA so the team can issue a return label and next steps, ask him to fill out our RMA form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSccBFl4kT-KBce4Dz2g6tJW-DKO6AiBUfsnDRKveTaPpEcmDA/viewform — with his order number Shop···· and a short description of the fault (VREG overheated, stopped hashing, UI unresponsive after reflash). Tell him that once the form is in, the team will follow up with the return label. Don't promise a specific date, and don't sign it as Georges.
Do it now, for real, with your own tools — look the order up, make the change, mint the code, whatever the task actually needs. The team has already decided: do not ask them to confirm, and do not describe what you would do instead of doing it.
Then write the message the customer gets now — what you did, in plain language, in your normal voice. Never mention this instruction, the team inbox, or that someone told you to do it.
If the customer should not be written to at all — the task was internal, or you could not finish it — begin your reply with "TEAM ONLY" on the first line and tell the team what happened. Anything that starts that way stays in the inbox and is never sent.

Hi David, thanks for sticking with the troubleshooting on this one, and sorry it ended up being the hardware.

To get your RMA opened, please fill out our RMA form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSccBFl4kT-KBce4Dz2g6tJW-DKO6AiBUfsnDRKveTaPpEcmDA/viewform

Put your order number, Shop····, and a short note on the fault: VREG overheated, stopped hashing, interface unresponsive after the reflash.

Once that's in, the team follows up with your prepaid return label and the next steps. One quick thing I should ask: was the unit ever overclocked?
